name: Amber Quartz
source:
There used to be a group of friends. They really trusted each other and their relationship never seemed to end. However, they gradually split up as time passed. Seven years later, Subaru now enjoys his school life with his friends and classmates. But when his old friends appear in front of him, his old memories come back...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
从前，有一群亲密的朋友。他们无比信任彼此，这段关系仿佛永远不会结束。然而随着时间流逝，众人逐渐分道扬镳。7年后，昴正与朋友和同学们享受着校园生活。可当昔日的伙伴出现在眼前，尘封的记忆也随之苏醒……

[摘自ErogeShop]
